about: Adaptive Pathway recall eval. One fictional user's belief store; each case is a single user message with the belief ids that should inject (expect), must not inject (forbid), and recall sections that should appear (expect_sections). Identity-layer beliefs may inject on any turn by design, so they are never forbidden. `kind` is not read by the engine yet (Phase 3.2); it labels which beliefs a counterpoint should target. Run: see the module docs of BigTinyV2/daemon/src/plugins/memory_eval.rs.
